title: Canadian Hangover Cure Papillote
description: A savory, comforting dish to help alleviate hangover symptoms and rejuvenate your senses.
instructions: Season the Canadian bacon with salt and black pepper.
In a separate bowl, mix together the potatoes, onions, and garlic.
Grease a large piece of parchment paper or aluminum foil with cooking spray.
Arrange the Canadian bacon slices on the prepared paper or foil, leaving space between each slice.
Top each bacon slice with a spoonful of the potato mixture.
Sprinkle the papillote greens over the top of the potato mixture.
Drizzle the beaten egg over the greens.
Sprinkle the hangover cure spice blend over the egg.
Fold the parchment paper or foil over the ingredients to create a packet.
Place the packets in the oven and bake for 20-25 minutes or until the potatoes are tender.
Serve hot and enjoy the cure!
